notes.title: Hotfix D0.01
notes.content:
Hello! The Demo is out and with that, bugs arise! Here is a quick patch to squash the most annoying ones and add some tweaks.

Fixes

 Corrected known spelling errors on some menus
 Remove extra sock from House 2
 Add collider behind House 3 bed to prevent items from falling behind


Tweaks

 Adjust House 1 Tutorial Text
 Update dice model and texture
 Rename some objects from plural to singular
 Rename [spoiler]Pink Burrito Roll[/spoiler] to [spoiler]Purple Burrito Roll[/spoiler]
 Adjust some item positions in Forest 3

notes.title: NOK x Tiny Teams + DEMO
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44222817/297fdf3650db777e9eaf114a790c66e5ed64b4e0.png
Hello Everyone! It's Steam Event time!
We are pleased to announce that NOK will be participating in Yogscast Games Tiny Teams Steam Event! ːsteamhappyː

This is the perfect opportunity to watch some streamers casually struggle to find socks and destroy environments.

Check out NOK and other amazing games here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023

New DEMO
We will also take this opportunity to announce that, an early DEMO of the game has become available for you to play TODAY so, hop in and give us some feedback & ideas!
STEAM DEMO LINK

We want to know your thoughts on NOK!
What could we do to improve? Is there something you would like to see? Did you find a pesky, annoying bug? We want all the juice! (If you just want to say hi, that's fine too, we don't bite... I think...) ːsteammockingː

Here is the link for the form: https://forms.gle/hBdcZg2unydyZpkU8
